experiment_class: predeclared synthetic developmental falsification, not original native first-use
motivation: Gate20 changed edges in 31/32 random-label worlds and lost to fully trained fixed and Bayesian controls. Test whether truly repeated action consequences and a disjoint training-only witness gate can reduce spurious structural rewiring without losing related-world predictive accuracy.

hypotheses.null: Independent random labels offer no persistent causal structure; hard-witness consensus must suppress unsupported graph changes.
hypotheses.alternative: A local rewiring rule with repeated-evidence confirmation will lower false-positive structural changes and held-out Brier on noise/unrelated worlds without material degradation on genuine causal shifts; outperforming fully fitted fixed and Bayesian models remains a separate necessary criterion.

contexts: B remapped source or B unrelated
worlds.deterministic_labeled_noise: for genuine causal families, each action-visit label flip with hash-based probability 1/20; independent-noise labels use an independent hash stream for every action and visit
worlds.hidden: true source/target parents, operator, remapping, family, held responses never visible to learner

data.A_training: 64 unique binary intervention action vectors, one witness each
data.B_training: 32 unique actions, each revisited 3 times in round order = 96 labeled experiences
data.B_fit_actions: 24 unique action IDs, three visits each =72 fit responses
data.B_sentinel_actions: 8 disjoint unique action IDs, three visits each =24 witness responses; eligibility gate only, never optimized by dynamic risk
data.B_held: 16 unseen unique action IDs, one independently generated label each, strictly excluded from source selection, fit and witness gates
data.split: seed-domain-shuffled disjoint action IDs and visit-specific deterministic noise
data.budget: same 64 A and 96 B labeled actions available to each arm, no teacher, 384-byte persisted evidence/metadata ceiling

mechanisms.source: A64, independent penalized leave-one-out best 1..3-parent mask, tie by ascending mask
mechanisms.online_gated: At B steps 32,64,96, score 1-edge add/prune/swap neighbors on available B-fit rows. Candidate needs B-fit LOO-Brier improvement >=0.008 and independent B-sentinel Brier improvement >=0.012, at least eight sentinel events and margin positive in two disjoint witness halves of accumulated sentinel sequence; at most one mutation per checkpoint; reject otherwise.
mechanisms.online_ungated: Same local candidates and B-fit risk, frequency and 0.008 threshold; no sentinel confirmation; use identical B events and 384-byte state.
mechanisms.fully_fit_fixed: Separately written exhaustive fitted static 1..3-parent selector over all 96 B observations, one global search, no online mutations, same source A available
mechanisms.bayesian: Fully trained fixed-subset Beta(1,1) Bayesian evidence mixture over all 1..3-parent masks using B96, equal model-order prior; more transient compute; quantify
mechanisms.frozen_A: Keep A mask, fit B labels using all B96
mechanisms.persistent: Save A64 rows, B96 rows, 1-byte active mask, source mask, edit counts, and compared-candidate work counter inside 384 bytes; cold B-step64 checkpoint and completed B96 double restore. This is deterministic same-process reconstruction, not process-exit/ native checkpoint.
mechanisms.work: Report candidate loss evaluations and compute costs, with no claimed equal compute, time or energy when unmatched.

scoring.held: Held Brier with all 16 B actions; lower better. Paired normal 95% CI across independent seed trials. Related composite across 128 seeds; negative outcomes per family.
scoring.structure: Gated and ungated edit counts and final parent masks. Count false structural changes in independent noise and unrelated source worlds; unrelated3 may legitimately require B adaptation, so do not label all such edits false.
scoring.verdict: All substantive thresholds together required for provisional structural scientific development gain; engineering replay PASS never scientific gain.

negative_controls: noise labels independently redrawn across repeated actions
strict_first_use: Freeze this JSON in Git before executable; commit executable separately before primary score; never tune thresholds or evaluated seeds after seeing outcome. Preserve negatives and original SHA lineage.
